fields.label: Store platform
fields.what: The Android or iOS Store listing that will use these images.
fields.why: The platforms use different folders and image slots.
fields.where: Choose an enabled platform from this project's saved Configuration.
fields.format: Android or iOS. This action uses saved settings, not unsaved form changes.
fields.failure: A disabled platform or changed saved configuration blocks import. No other listing is changed.

fields.label: Listing language
fields.what: The language and region of the listing that should show these images.
fields.why: Images with localized text must be kept with the correct listing language.
fields.where: Choose a saved metadata locale. Add a missing language on the Configuration screen first.
fields.format: A configured locale such as en-US or fr-FR; choose it from the list.
fields.failure: An unconfigured locale is refused. Import does not translate an image or add a language automatically.

fields.label: Image slot or device size
fields.what: Where this image belongs, such as a Play icon, phone screenshots or an Apple display size.
fields.why: Store tools distinguish these slots and can require exact dimensions.
fields.where: Use the slot requested by your Store listing. For Apple, match the screenshot device and dimensions shown here.
fields.format: Choose one supported slot for this batch. Apple dimensions come from the project's pinned Store tool.
fields.failure: An unsupported type, mismatched Apple dimensions, duplicate image or excessive set blocks the affected import. This is not Store approval.

fields.label: Select image files
fields.requiredWhen: For a new import; recovery does not need source files.
fields.what: The PNG or JPEG screenshots or artwork to copy into this project's public Store metadata.
fields.why: The app registers the copies in the correct locale and image slot for you.
fields.where: Capture your app's screen or select the approved files supplied by your designer. Use the native Select files button.
fields.format: Up to 10 PNG/JPEG images, 10 MiB each and 24 MiB together. A single-image slot accepts one file.
fields.failure: Wrong formats, invalid headers, changed files or a large batch are refused. Select a corrected or smaller batch; no partial import is hidden.

fields.label: Replace this existing project image
fields.requiredWhen: Only when intentionally replacing the exact same public destination file.
fields.what: Replace the existing project copy with this selected image.
fields.why: Keeping the existing image is the default so your work is not overwritten accidentally.
fields.where: Compare the existing, selected and resulting image details in this preview before checking the option.
fields.format: An explicit choice for this file only. Identical contents are kept unchanged. A different format in a single-image slot is a conflict.
fields.failure: If the file, configuration or preview changes, confirmation is stale and replacement is refused. The selected original source file is never overwritten.

fields.label: Confirm local public copies
fields.what: Consent to create or explicitly replace the public project files shown in this preview.
fields.why: These copies may be committed to your repository and later uploaded by a separate reviewed release operation.
fields.where: Review the exact destinations, image details and resulting order here. Check that the images contain no private information.
fields.format: Confirm this preview only. Originals stay where you selected them; nothing is moved or uploaded.
fields.failure: Header checks do not decode all pixels, detect private image content or prove Store acceptance. Cancellation after Apply may not undo a committed copy.

fields.label: Confirm reviewed image recovery
fields.requiredWhen: Before a recoverable interrupted image transaction is restored or cleaned up.
fields.what: A new, explicitly reviewed attempt to finish recovery of an interrupted local image import.
fields.why: An interruption can leave either uncommitted changes to restore or committed images with cleanup still pending.
fields.where: Choose Inspect image recovery, then read whether the preview restores originals or keeps committed images and removes only owned leftovers.
fields.format: Confirm the current inspected action. Do not move, edit or delete the hidden recovery files yourself.
fields.failure: Changed, incomplete or unrecognized state is preserved as a conflict. Recovery does not retry import, touch Store state or assume that a missing reply means success.
